name: OnionHEN
summary: Modular all-in-one HEN and toolbox with FTP, game mounting, cheats and an overlay.
description: A payload stack that prepares the system, injects a ShellUI toolbox, and runs overlays, cheats, payloads and background services. Includes an embedded FTP server, game scanner/mounter, Remote Play pairing and an in-game performance overlay.
author: ps3120

firmware.notes: Requires an external elfldr on port 9021 for the first hop.

warnings: Does not include a kernel exploit; you still need an entry point.
